$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F06 front (A1). Its lens is one shield seen through the front's two openings, a gradient from smoke to clear; each opening is its own lens entry, not convex (the nose arch bites into it). The temples seen through the lens go with the gradient refit; at the top of the image-left opening SAM left the dark temple out of the lens, where it opens onto the rim, so it is added by hand (lenses.add).

lenses.name: shield lens, wearer's right half (image left)
shield lens, wearer's left half (image right)
